summary: ```markdown # CLO Techniques Workshop - Creating a Loop Knot In this video, I will show you how to make a twist panel as shown in the video. Today, let's make a twist panel as shown in the video. ## Scoring the Seam Allowance First, let's use the **Plus Point Line Tool** to score. This is a reference for the position of the seam allowance. Then, we switch to the **Edit Panel Tool** and use the **Internal Line Tool**. In the position we need to add, add an internal line of **1 to 8 mm**. Note that if you need to cancel the extension of the internal line here, you will create an internal line in parallel. This internal line will be our reference line for adding the seam allowance. ## Adding the Internal Circle Next, we add the **Internal Circle** on the end point of the corresponding internal line. Set the diameter to **10 mm** and then click **OK**. This circle represents the position of the twist panel that we want to fix. Now, let's copy it and paste it out. Click on the position that needs to be pasted and click **OK**. You can see that there are several points that need to be pasted. ## Separating Points on the Internal Circle Next, let's separate the points on the internal circle. This is convenient for the next process. Since we only need a semi-circular fixed panel line here, we delete the other half. Now we have a semi-circular shape. ## Using the Twist Tool Next, we use the **Twist Tool** to add the extension at the center point of the corresponding circle. Then, switch to the **Select Move Twist Tool**. First, copy the first twist. Then, right-click on the appropriate position and paste the twist to the position below. It is the same process: right-click on the position that needs to be pasted, and you can add multiple extension twists. ## Setting the Twist Layer Then, we need to set the twist layer. Harden the panels in the middle to make them a little closer to the center. You can also make the two-layer panels flatter. Then, turn off the simulation. ## Setting the Sewing Layer Next, set the layer of sewing here. I have two layers here, and again, you can make the two-layer panels flatter. Then, turn off the simulation. ## Adding Extensions Next, we use the **Twist Tool** to add the extension. The width is set to **30 mm**, and the height is set to **1 mm**. We switch to the **Add Point Division Tool**. First, add a point to the edge to make it easier to locate. Then, right-click on the position at the bottom edge. Switch to the **Length Division**. In the middle, separate a section of **8 mm** in length. Set the direction as the center. This section will align with our half-circle position. Go to the center to make a seam. Ensure the two ends of the panel line are fixed to the other side. Pay attention to the direction of the seam on both ends. The middle can be separated a little bit. ## Final Adjustments After the seam is finished, we choose this panel line. Press the **3D Window Key**. Move it to the seam position. Rotate the view and pull it out a little bit. Remember to modify the particle diameter of the panel. Freeze the panel in the back. After adjusting the particle diameter, simulate and adjust it a little. Apply the corresponding fabric to it. Based on the fabric to be applied to the panel line, copy a new fabric and change it to a relatively hard physical attribute. You can see the effect of the panel line after simulation. ## Repeating the Process Then, copy the remaining panel line. Here, repeat the operation of the first panel line. Go to the panel line on both sides and sew it. Do the same to fix the position of the panel line. Then, untie the two panels. Select all the buttons and then turn off the conflict. Simulate. ## Finalizing the Panel Line Select the panel line and change the particle diameter to **3**. Correct the global settings, then change the bundle thickness to **1**. Turn on the panel line, then gently pull the toggle. Use the button even to propose this gotcha HTML function. Open both of the couplings again. Again, simulate. Finally, unseal the panel. Add an adhesive strip to the position close to the back and set it as a **5-way stretch**. Then this twist is finished here. ```
